question: Does retuning the CS2 ARK rating every month beat keeping its settings fixed?
answer: The monthly retune passes, and retunes ship monthly: -0.0018 log loss per series, t by month -8.66 (bar -2.00), through 2026-10.
findings: It won 16 of 16 months. On top-50 series, t = -0.06.
The calibration slope is 0.964 on 15,957 scored series.
Settings picked: span 0.3 (14 months), K 384 (2 months).
method: Each month, the settings with the lowest log loss on all earlier series are picked from the shipped set and from one-step moves on K, K decay, map K, lower-tier K, region K, span and new-player start. They are then scored once on that month against the shipped settings.
data: Valve VRS series + bo3.gg maps, Aug 2024 to 2026-10, 15,957 walk-forward series.
